title: Double interaction principle for the Lorentz force equation
summary: In this paper we study the Lorentz force equation using the Poincare action functional. We show that, if the scalar electric potential has good interactions at infinity and around the origin with the vector magnetic potential, then the Lorentz force equation has at least two periodic solutions with a fixed period. For the proof of our main result we introduce a new minimax theorem for the Poincare action functional that does not require the Palais-Smale compactness condition and provides the existence of twin critical points.
